whenNotToUse: Minified CSS is painful to debug — always keep the beautified source as your working copy and minify only at release time.
It does not do advanced optimizations (merging duplicate rules, removing unused selectors, autoprefixing) — those need a build tool like PostCSS or Lightning CSS.
